methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
This paper presents the requirements for en-
ergy management from the perspective of 
the International Organisation for Standard-
isation, European Union and the interna-
tional and current European legal situation.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: No identifiable EnPI/EnB measurement model; the paper discusses standards, directives, PDCA, and monitoring components.

paper_type.evidence_quote:
This paper is organised as follows: section 
2 reviews the legal framework for the en-
forcement of energy efficiency; section 3 
proposed an overview of examples how en-
ergymanagement is implemented, section 4 
is on the result analysis while section 5 is on 
conclusion and future work.

stage1.notes: The paper gives generic EnMS monitoring and PDCA examples but no characterised EnPI/EnB model.
